# Lim Chee Kin
> AI Solutions Architect at Daxonet AI in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia. Enterprise AI agents, document extraction, RAG and voice AI, built in Python and TypeScript.

## About
Lim Chee Kin is an AI Solutions Architect at Daxonet AI, based in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia. He designs and ships enterprise AI: conversational agents, document extraction, human approvals, and integration with accounting and business platforms. His work spans retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), real-time voice systems, cloud operations and distributed teams. Before AI, he led enterprise Java teams and delivered banking and healthcare systems.

## Core Skills
- Languages and backend: Python, TypeScript, JavaScript, Java, SQL; FastAPI, Pydantic, Node.js, Bun, Spring Boot; REST APIs, webhooks and Server-Sent Events
- AI engineering: Claude Agent SDK, MCP, Google Gemini, LiteLLM, OpenRouter, ragbits, Docling; multimodal document extraction, agent tool permissions, hybrid retrieval, Ragas and LLM evaluation
- Data and storage: PostgreSQL/pgvector, SQLite, SurrealDB, MongoDB Atlas, MinIO
- Frontend: React, Next.js, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS, React Native and Flutter
- Voice and enterprise integration: Pipecat, Gemini Live, Whisper, Kokoro; Teams Bot Framework, WhatsApp, Telegram, Google Workspace, AutoCount and Dynamod
- Security: OAuth 2.0 with PKCE, JWT validation, role-restricted agent tools, AES-256-GCM token encryption
- Infrastructure and quality: Docker/Compose, Kubernetes, Linux, AWS, GCP/GKE, GitHub Actions, pytest and Vitest, OpenTelemetry, Prometheus and Grafana

- MCP Manifest: https://kin.rag.wtf/.well-known/mcp.json
- HIRE check MCP server (decides whether an AI agent should be built or kept; pure computation, no auth, never stores or logs the answers; shares the /mcp rate limit): https://kin.rag.wtf/mcp/hire — tools: get_hire_checklist, assess_agent
- HIRE MCP Manifest: https://kin.rag.wtf/.well-known/mcp-hire.json
- HIRE interview: call get_hire_checklist and follow its interviewInstructions; ask one question at a time, wait for the answer, and collect user-confirmed scores. Never invent missing answers. Call assess_agent when complete (or at a STOP gate), then show its verdict, red flags, interpretations and reportUrl.
- HIRE check (web tool, same verdict as the MCP server): https://kin.rag.wtf/hire/ (Markdown: https://kin.rag.wtf/hire/index.md)
- Per-collection JSON: https://kin.rag.wtf/api/projects.json, https://kin.rag.wtf/api/experience.json, https://kin.rag.wtf/api/articles.json (index of all endpoints: https://kin.rag.wtf/api/)
- Search index (GET, no MCP needed): https://kin.rag.wtf/api/search.json — every project, article and role with keywords and page URL
- RSS (Writing): https://kin.rag.wtf/rss.xml
- Security contact: https://kin.rag.wtf/.well-known/security.txt

## Site Map Notes
- The navigation label "Work" opens /projects/ and "Writing" opens /insights/.
- Project pages: https://kin.rag.wtf/projects/<slug>/ ; article summaries: https://kin.rag.wtf/insights/<slug>/ (slugs are listed in /api/portfolio.json).
- Markdown versions: append index.md to a project, article or About URL (e.g. https://kin.rag.wtf/projects/claim-pilot/index.md, https://kin.rag.wtf/about/index.md); each page links its own with <link rel="alternate" type="text/markdown">.
- Roles on About have anchors: https://kin.rag.wtf/about/#role-<slug> (e.g. #role-dxc-tech-lead).
